x.Material & Structure Portfolio: Breadth of film types (PE, PP, PET, foil, etc.) and multilayer structures offered. Strength shown by diverse product lines for various applications like food, beverage, and industrial packaging.
x.Barrier & Protection Performance: Ability to provide barriers against oxygen, moisture, light, and aroma to extend shelf life. Evidence includes proprietary barrier technologies, high-performance films, and certifications for sensitive products.
x.Converting & Manufacturing Capability: In-house capabilities in extrusion, lamination, printing, and slitting. Strength indicated by advanced machinery, production efficiency, and quality control systems.
x.Sustainability & Circular Design: Use of recyclable, biodegradable, or source-reduced materials, and design for recyclability. Evidence includes certifications like APR, use of post-consumer recycled content, and partnerships for circular economy.
x.Regulatory & Food-Contact Compliance: Adherence to global food-contact regulations (FDA, EU, etc.) and safety standards. Strength shown by certifications, compliance documentation, and track record of safe products.

y.Geographic Market Coverage: Presence in key regions (North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific) and ability to serve global customers. Evidence includes manufacturing sites, sales offices, and distribution networks.
y.Customer Base & Brand Reach: Diversity and loyalty of customers, including major FMCG brands and converters. Strength indicated by long-term contracts, repeat business, and reputation in the market.
y.Financial Performance & Stability: Revenue growth, profitability, and balance sheet strength. Evidence includes financial reports, credit ratings, and consistent investment in the business.
y.Innovation & R&D Pipeline: Investment in R&D and pipeline of new products or technologies. Strength shown by patents, new product launches, and collaborations with research institutions.
y.Capacity Expansion & Investments: Plans and actions to increase production capacity or acquire new capabilities. Evidence includes announced expansions, new plants, and capital expenditure trends.

xy_scoring.axis_definition_reason: These parameters capture the core technical and commercial drivers in flexible packaging: material innovation, barrier performance, sustainability, regulatory compliance, and global market reach, which are critical for competitive positioning.
